description: This file contains functions and variables for dynamically splitting GStreamer plugin packages into separate sub-packages within a Yocto build system, including generating a meta package that depends on all plugin packages.

methods.name: split_gstreamer10_packages
methods.description: Dynamically creates separate packages for each GStreamer plugin or library by matching filenames and setting dependencies accordingly.

methods.name: set_metapkg_rdepends
methods.description: Sets the runtime dependencies for the meta package including filtering out empty or excluded packages.
